subject: [PATCH v4 07/21] ntfs3: convert iomap ops to ->iomap_next()

2026-07-27.patch_summary: This patch converts the ntfs3 file system's iomap operations to use the new ->iomap_next() callback, which is generated using a macro that wraps the iomap_iter_next() helper to finish previous mappings and produce the next one. The conversion does not introduce any functional changes. Instead, it updates the existing code to conform to the latest API requirements.
